column3: The PSU-450 series converts single-phase mains into a stable 24 V or 48 V supply for control cabinets. All models are cooled by natural convection and need no fan.
Wide input range for use on any mains supply
Power reserve of 20% for five seconds
DC OK relay contact for remote monitoring
